item.title: 62 Keep Warm In The 180 Center
item.description: When Shakona Williams sleeps outside, she usually goes to her spot — a “cubby,” a little private nook, the location of which she keeps to herself. She had a warmer place to sleep on Sunday night: a mat inside the 180 Center, where she could lay next to her partner and watch the snow swirl. The post 62 Keep Warm In The 180 Center appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Pride Center To “Cease Normal Operations”
item.description: The New Haven Pride Center announced Monday that it will "cease normal operations" starting Thursday, Feb. 26. "Hopefully it’s temporary," said Board President Hope Chávez in an interview on Monday afternoon. According to Chávez, the Pride Center's staff will be furloughed and the physical space will close down starting this Thursday. The post Pride Center To “Cease Normal Operations” appeared first on New Haven Independent.
